_about: When the game offers the next thing: every number that says when a call may ring or an offer may come, in seconds of play unless it says hours. [a, b] seconds means a random time between a and b; hours [from, to] may run past midnight (17 to 2). Each source keeps its own countdown and reads its numbers here (pacer.gd). How long a card stays up, distances, and the offers that come from driving past a place (deliveries, the round-up, rivals' challenges, friends met in person) have no clock and are not here. check_pacing.gd checks this file.

calls._note: Every friend's call: at least gap s after the last call of anyone ended (answered), decline_gap s after one the player turned down or let ring out, decline_max s after two or more no's in a row (an answer resets it), settle s into a calm spell (after a result, a chase or a quest), and quiet s after a run of any activity ended. Every card that comes by itself (a call, a ride request, a drive-past order, the guide's cards) also waits spacing s after the last card closed, and quiet s after a run ended. Whoever rang last lets a call that is due and waiting go first (variety). A call the player asked for does not wait. F 2026-11-19: a few calls in 10 s, one minute between calls too fast.

time._note: The game clock (game_time.gd). by_day 1: the night friends (shisha, bar crawl, racing club, Mati's raves) call at any hour, and saying yes jumps the clock to their opening hour; 0: they call only in their hours. F 2026-11-19: show the night activities by day too, the time changes when the player picks the quest. The game clock (time_of_day.gd, F 2026-11-19): speed 30 = one game day in 48 real minutes, one game hour in 2; the sun by the game's date in Warsaw (a new game starts at 14:00 on this week's Friday); golden 2.5 = the hour and a half round sunrise and sunset lasts 2.5 times longer than in life (like GTA), taken from midday and midnight; look_every = the light is worked out again every this many real seconds.

rescue._note: The rescue line (WEZWANIE): the first call this long after the start, the next this long after a rescue ends or is skipped.

activity._note: The default for an activity of the kit that sets nothing of its own: the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

boat._note: Szymek's boat race: between these hours, the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

kino._note: The cinema tour: between these hours, the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

dekalog._note: The Dekalog tour: between these hours, the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

shisha._note: Ivan's shisha night: between these hours; the first call, then the next after a night or a no; a call that could not ring tries again after retry s.

crawl._note: The bar crawl: between these hours; the first call, then the next after a crawl or a no; retry as above.

meet._note: Darek's night racing club: between these hours; the first call, then the next after a night or a no; retry as above.

rave._note: Mati's nights: his tease between tease_hours, the first after first_tease s and the next after next_tease s; his call call_after s after the tease; retry as above.

ev_tow._note: Bartek's EV tow: the first call, then the next after a tow or a no; retry as above. The stranded cars: the first after first_strand s, the next strand_gap s after one clears.

rides._note: Łuber: the first request after first_offer s of driving, then offer_gap s after each ride or request; a request held by the first minutes' guide comes at least hold_gap s after the hold lets go.

first_steps._note: The first hour's guide (first10.gd, first hour step 3): the beta card (the activities, SEE QUESTS) beta_after s after the first delivery (or the kebab let go), beta_latest s at the latest; the one choice card choice_after_beta s of free driving after it and choice_after s after the first delivery (or the first kebab let go), choice_latest s at the latest; the next First steps intro after next_gap s of free driving and next_gap s after the last one. Friends' calls wait for friends_steps ticked steps (a count, not seconds) or friends_after s of play, then at most one new friend every new_friend_gap s while the guide runs; once open they stay open in later sessions. F 2026-11-22: a player who skips the First steps and just drives must get calls too, so friends_after is 3 minutes (was 12); each friend's own first_call and the calls gap keep it calm.

trend._note: The trend courier's orders. Dżemini: first after dz_first s, again dz_cool s after a skip. Kawa: between kawa_hours, first after kawa_first s, then every kawa_cool s. Deski (padel): between deski_hours, first after deski_first s, then every deski_cool s. A slot offers again after slot_cool s; Mlask between ml_hours, again after ml_cool s. card_rest s after a card closes before the next offer; call_rest s after a rescue ends before a friend's call.

tajny._note: The Tajny klient opening (tajny_klient.gd): Kebabulo rings call_at s into the first drive, again retry s after a no; his call card lives ring_life s; the kebab is warm for warm s from Kemal's counter; DŻEMINI's bribe comes bribe_at s into that drive and waits bribe_life s; the banners stay banner s.
